categories.name: Warmup Phase
messages: Engine warming up — establishing your rhythm.
Baseline locked in. Settle into a smooth, steady glide.
First few minutes in the bank — momentum is building!
Body warm, mind sharp. Focus on consistent breathing.
Easy does it — the first win of the day is simply showing up.
Loose shoulders, quiet feet. We ease into the work ahead.

categories.name: Mid-Workout Cruising
messages: Cadence is locked. Let your legs carry the effort.
Banking effort minutes — smooth, disciplined work.
Putting distance behind you. Cruising steady at {pct}%.
Rhythm is effortless now. Stay locked into the story.
Time check: {time_left} of runway left, and you are flying.
This is the part champions make look boring — steady and relentless.

categories.name: 50% Halfway Threshold
messages: HALFWAY MARK! Every step now counts down toward the finish line.
Flipping the script — you have less time ahead than behind you!
Over the crest! Gravity and momentum carry you home from here.
50% in the bank! Time to lock in and finish what you started.
Half the clock gone, half the excuses gone with it.
The story turns here — everything from now on is house money.

categories.name: Homestretch
messages: Quarter of the session left! Stay tall and hold your form.
Single-digit minutes on the horizon. Pushing through the homestretch!
Visualizing the finish line — drive through the heel stride.
75% completed! Clear runway all the way to the finish.
{pct}% done. The finish line is no longer a rumour.
Legs heavy, heart game. This is where grit pays out.

categories.name: Final Sprint
messages: Final push! Dig deep and leave nothing on the table!
Under 10% remaining — empty the tank!
Seconds away from completion — finish strong and tall!
{time_left} left. Everything you have, right now.
No pacing needed anymore — pure, honest effort to the buzzer.
